feature: Ask's component sheet: every label kept, grown parts centred
summary: When Ask draws a component whose later states move a selection (a segmented control), the labels no longer disappear, and a part that grows in a state (a pressed slider knob) stays centred on its track.
setup: Photonz Dev, release Next, no switch changed from its default, a blank picture 1440 by 1024, the built-in Qwen3.8 27B model.

try.do: File > New > Image, then press Ask (Command K).
Type: create a table of apple like quality base components that show different states and text, and press Send.
Wait for it (four to six and a half minutes on this Mac).
Look at the Slider row: the pressed knob sits on the middle of its track.
Compare with the build before: the Segmented Control lost its First label and the pressed knob sat under its track.
Press Command Z once: the whole sheet goes.

evaluate: Does every segmented control state still show all its labels?
Does the pressed slider knob sit on its track?
Would you rather have Checkbox and Radio under their own Off and On header, as in the tried picture (2026-11-02-component-sheet-header-per-kind-tried.png), or sharing Toggle's as now?
